title: Freight Forwarding
imageAlt: Aerial view of a container ship at sea
metaDescription: International freight forwarding by air, sea and road from Tema, Ghana. Blahar & Benyah handles documentation, carrier selection, customs clearance and delivery.
short: Blahar & Benyah Int’l Ltd delivers structured freight forwarding solutions designed to simplify global cargo movement.
card: We deliver strategic freight forwarding solutions that simplify global cargo movement and reduce operational complexity. Our team manages every detail from documentation to final delivery with precision, speed, and full regulatory compliance.
paragraphs: At Blahar & Benyah Int’l Ltd, we provide comprehensive freight forwarding services designed to make cargo movement seamless and stress-free. Our team manages shipments across air, sea, and land, coordinating every step from pickup to final delivery.

We handle all the critical aspects of international and domestic shipping, including documentation, customs clearance, carrier selection, and route planning. Our focus is on timely delivery, cost efficiency, and regulatory compliance, ensuring your goods reach their destination safely and on schedule.

By combining industry expertise with modern logistics solutions, we simplify complex shipping processes and reduce operational risks. Whether you’re moving large shipments or specialized cargo, our freight forwarding services are tailored to meet your unique business needs.
Partner with us to experience reliable, professional, and efficient freight management that supports your growth and strengthens your supply chain.
bullets: Air, sea and road freight — import and export

Door-to-door delivery and shipment tracking updates
blurb: Air, sea and road freight, import and export — booked, documented and tracked from origin to Tema or Kotoka.
highlights: Carrier selection, booking and route planning
